QuestInfo.0:
Use a Lv. 1 or higher Hologram skill 10 times in the dungeon.
Must be completed within a single dungeon attempt.
To obtain Hologram skills, equip special equipment in the Quanah world.
You will receive Libae's special equipment as a separate additional reward upon completing the quest.
